summary: @ornikar/stylelint-config 14.0.7 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: Version 14.0.7 of this stylelint config declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, unzips it, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync (falling back to a preexisting system bun if present). math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line file heavily obfuscated with rotated string-array packing (WV8StW push/shift rotator, hex-named identifiers such as _0x488df8) and thousands of packed constants; setup.mjs and math_init.js share the same obfuscator style. A stylelint configuration package has no functional need for a second language runtime, and the legitimate ornikar/shared-configs repository referenced in the metadata contains no preinstall hook, no setup.mjs, and no math_init.js — this release smuggles a dropper under a trusted package name. On npm install, the obfuscated bytes are handed to a freshly-downloaded alien runtime, bypassing Node-based scanning and giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
